description.en: Adds an Open in VS Code action to each workspace row in the DSH web sidebar.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 侧栏的每个工作区菜单中加入“在 VS Code 中打开”操作。

note.en: The pinned root package declares dsh.bundle.patch and committed runtime output. Review does not imply a security audit.
note.zh: 固定版本的仓库根包声明了 dsh.bundle.patch，且提交了运行产物；收录不等于安全审计。

readme.en:
## What it adds

A workspace row-menu contribution calls a host Remote that launches the configured editor for the selected directory. It does not expose model tools or read and write workspace files itself.
readme.zh:
## 它增加了什么

工作区行菜单通过 Host Remote 启动配置好的编辑器并打开所选目录。插件不暴露模型工具，也不自行读写工作区文件。

limitations.en: Requires an editor CLI such as `code` on the host PATH, or an explicit command configuration.
limitations.zh: 宿主机 PATH 中需要 `code` 等编辑器 CLI，或显式配置启动命令。

description.en: Adds Codex-style @file mentions to the web composer and expands selected workspace files into the model request.
description.zh: 为 Web 输入框加入 Codex 风格的 @file 提及，并在发送时把所选工作区文件展开到模型请求。

note.en: The pinned root package declares dsh.bundle.patch and committed runtime output. Review does not imply a security audit.
note.zh: 固定版本的仓库根包声明了 dsh.bundle.patch，且提交了运行产物；收录不等于安全审计。

readme.en:
## What it adds

Typing `@` opens a workspace file picker. Attached files remain readable tokens in the draft and are expanded by the host at the agent pre-step boundary.
readme.zh:
## 它增加了什么

输入 `@` 会打开工作区文件选择器。附件在草稿中仍是可读的路径 token，并由 Host 在 agent pre-step 边界展开。

modelExperience.en: Selected file contents enter the request as user-role file blocks; no model tool call is required.
modelExperience.zh: 所选文件内容会作为用户角色文件块进入请求，不需要模型调用工具。

limitations.en: Binary, oversized, or workspace-escaping paths are skipped; mention tokens cannot contain whitespace.
limitations.zh: 二进制、超限或逃逸工作区的路径会被跳过；提及 token 不能包含空格。

description.en: Shows configurable browser desktop notifications when a DSH session finishes a turn.
description.zh: 当 DSH 会话完成一轮时显示可配置的浏览器桌面通知。

note.en: The pinned root package declares dsh.bundle.patch and committed runtime output. Review does not imply a security audit.
note.zh: 固定版本的仓库根包声明了 dsh.bundle.patch，且提交了运行产物；收录不等于安全审计。

readme.en:
## What it adds

A bounded host projection describes the last completed turn. The browser applies local include and exclude rules and uses the Notification API after permission is granted.
readme.zh:
## 它增加了什么

Host 提供上一轮完成状态的有界投影；浏览器在获得通知权限后，本地应用包含与排除规则并调用 Notification API。

modelExperience.en: UI-only. It adds no tools, prompt text, or session events.
modelExperience.zh: 仅影响 UI，不增加工具、提示词或会话事件。

limitations.en: The page must remain open and browser notification permission must be granted.
limitations.zh: 页面需要保持打开，并且必须授予浏览器通知权限。

description.en: Renders interactive components, charts, forms, and panels from model-produced dsh-ui fences inside assistant replies.
description.zh: 把模型输出的 dsh-ui fence 渲染为助手回复中的交互组件、图表、表单和面板。

tools.name: render_ui
tools.description: Render a guarded dsh-ui specification in the tool row.

tools.name: validate_dsh_ui
tools.description: Validate a dsh-ui specification before rendering it.

note.en: The pinned root package declares dsh.bundle.patch and committed runtime output. Review does not imply a security audit.
note.zh: 固定版本的仓库根包声明了 dsh.bundle.patch，且提交了运行产物；收录不等于安全审计。

readme.en:
## What it adds

The model can describe a whitelisted UI tree in a `dsh-ui` fence. The browser renders it inline, while guarded actions can return interaction data to the model.
readme.zh:
## 它增加了什么

模型可以在 `dsh-ui` fence 中描述白名单 UI 树，浏览器将其内联渲染，并通过受约束的 action 把交互数据返回给模型。

modelExperience.en: Adds fence-format instructions plus render_ui and validate_dsh_ui tools; rich output can increase response tokens.
modelExperience.zh: 会增加 fence 格式说明以及 render_ui、validate_dsh_ui 工具；富 UI 输出可能提高回复 token 消耗。

limitations.en: Requires compatible web composition and on-demand assets; interactive actions depend on the page and model loop remaining available.
limitations.zh: 需要兼容的 Web 组合与按需资源；交互 action 依赖页面和模型循环保持可用。

description.en: A full-screen Claude Code-style terminal front door for DSH agents, mounted as a Cordis bundle.
description.zh: 以 Cordis 组合包挂载的 Claude Code 风格全屏终端入口，用于操作 DSH Agent。

note.en: The pinned root package declares dsh.bundle.patch and committed runtime output. Review does not imply a security audit.
note.zh: 固定版本的仓库根包声明了 dsh.bundle.patch，且提交了运行产物；收录不等于安全审计。

readme.en:
## What it adds

A terminal-native conversation surface with streaming reasoning, tool cards, session resume and rewind, command and file completion, context meters, and keyboard navigation.
readme.zh:
## 它增加了什么

提供终端原生会话界面，包括流式思考、工具卡片、会话恢复与回溯、命令和文件补全、上下文仪表与键盘导航。

modelExperience.en: Uses the normal DSH agent, session, tool, and persistence services through a terminal-specific profile layer.
modelExperience.zh: 通过终端专用 Profile 层复用 DSH 的 Agent、会话、工具和持久化服务。

limitations.en: The profile intentionally does not consume the DSH approval UI flow, and several Claude Code-named commands are explicit compatibility placeholders.
limitations.zh: 该 Profile 暂不消费 DSH 审批 UI 流，部分 Claude Code 同名命令是明确标注的兼容占位。
